name: @saas/agent
description: Windows background service to sync TallyPrime with the SaaS cloud platform

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const targetDir = path.resolve('../web/public/tally-agent-windows'); fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/tally-agent.mjs', path.join(targetDir, 'tally-agent.mjs')); const winDir = path.resolve('windows'); if (fs.existsSync(winDir)) { for (const f of fs.readdirSync(winDir)) { if (f !== 'node.exe' && f !== 'tally-agent.mjs') fs.copyFileSync(path.join(winDir, f), path.join(targetDir, f)); } } console.log('[Build] Propagated tally-agent.mjs and windows scripts to ' + targetDir);"
